content:
# Crossplane: `XAppStack` XRD + Composition (functions/pipeline mode)

Layout:

```
crossplane/
  functions.yaml                     # function-patch-and-transform + auto-ready
  providers.yaml                     # provider-aws-{s3,rds,iam}
  providerconfigs/
    dev.yaml   prod.yaml             # per-env AWS creds/region isolation
  definition/xappstack.yaml          # XRD
  composition/xappstack-aws.yaml     # Composition (pipeline mode)
  claims/
    dev.yaml   prod.yaml             # the only env-specific input
```

---

## 1. `functions.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.4.1
```

## 2. `providers.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata: { name: provider-aws-s3 }
spec: { package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-s3:v1.16.0 }
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata: { name: provider-aws-rds }
spec: { package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-rds:v1.16.0 }
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata: { name: provider-aws-iam }
spec: { package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-iam:v1.16.0 }
```

## 3. `providerconfigs/dev.yaml` / `prod.yaml`

Environment isolation is at the **ProviderConfig** level — separate AWS accounts/roles, so a prod apply can never touch dev state.

```yaml
# dev.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata: { name: aws-dev }
spec:
  credentials:
    source: IRSA          # Crossplane pod SA assumes the dev deploy role
---
# prod.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata: { name: aws-prod }
spec:
  credentials:
    source: IRSA
```

---

## 4. `definition/xappstack.yaml` — XRD

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: xappstack-aws
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - endpoint
    - port
    - username
    - password
    - bucket
    - roleArn
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: [dev, prod]
                region:
                  type: string
                  default: us-east-1
                providerConfigName:
                  type: string
                  description: aws-dev | aws-prod
                deletionPolicy:
                  type: string
                  enum: [Delete, Orphan]
                  default: Delete

                bucket:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    name: { type: string }
                    kmsKeyArn:
                      type: string
                      description: If set, SSE-KMS is used instead of AES256.
                    replicaRegion:
                      type: string
                      description: Enables CRR when set (prod = us-west-2).
                  required: [name]

                database:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro
                    allocatedStorage:
                      type: integer
                      default: 20
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    backupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 7
                      default: 7
                    engineVersion:
                      type: string
                      default: "15.7"
                    subnetGroupName: { type: string }
                    vpcSecurityGroupIds:
                      type: array
                      items: { type: string }
                    passwordSecretRef:
                      description: |
                        Pre-existing k8s Secret holding the master password.
                        Created by External Secrets / SOPS - never in Git plaintext.
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        namespace: { type: string }
                        name:      { type: string }
                        key:       { type: string, default: password }
                      required: [namespace, name]
                  required: [subnetGroupName, passwordSecretRef]

                serviceAccount:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    oidcProviderArn:  { type: string }
                    oidcProviderHost: { type: string, description: "oidc.eks.<region>.amazonaws.com/id/XXXX" }
                    namespace:        { type: string, default: default }
                    name:             { type: string }
                  required: [oidcProviderArn, oidcProviderHost, name]
              required: [environment, providerConfigName, bucket, database, serviceAccount]
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketName:  { type: string }
                dbEndpoint:  { type: string }
                roleArn:     { type: string }
```

---

## 5. `composition/xappstack-aws.yaml` — Composition (pipeline)

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xappstack-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  writeConnectionSecretsToNamespace: crossplane-system
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef: { name: function-patch-and-transform }
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources

        patchSets:
          - name: common
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.labels[crossplane.io/claim-name]
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.app

        resources:

          # ---------- S3 ----------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucket.name
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                toFieldPath: status.connectionDetails.bucket

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled          # AC1
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - bucketKeyEnabled: true
                      applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256   # AC1; overridden to aws:kms below
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucket.kmsKeyArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].kmsMasterKeyId
                policy: { fromFieldPath: Optional }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucket.kmsKeyArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].sseAlgorithm
                policy: { fromFieldPath: Optional }
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Convert, convert: ToLower }
                  - type: map
                    map: {}          # any non-empty kms arn -> aws:kms
                    # simpler: use the literal below
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "aws:kms" }

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true          # AC1: no public access
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------
          - name: rds
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  username: appuser
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true            # AC2
                  deletionProtection: true          # AC2
                  publiclyAccessible: false         # AC2
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: ""       # patched
                  applyImmediately: false
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  performanceInsightsEnabled: true
                  enabledCloudwatchLogsExports: [postgresql, upgrade]
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.engineVersion
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.engineVersion
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.backupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod   # AC2 >= 7 (XRD minimum)
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.subnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.vpcSecurityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds
              # master password comes from an existing Secret (SOPS/ESO managed) - AC3
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "%s-rds" }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.labels[crossplane.io/claim-name]
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "%s-final" }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
            connectionDetails:
              - name: endpoint
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
              - name: port
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
              - name: username
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              - name: password
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: attribute.password

          # ---------- IAM role for service account (IRSA) ----------
          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment
              # OIDC trust policy, scoped to exactly one namespace/SA - AC4
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccount.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccount.oidcProviderHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccount.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccount.name
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccount.oidcProviderHost
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [{
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": { "Federated": "%s" },
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                          "Condition": {
                            "StringEquals": {
                              "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s",
                              "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                            }
                          }
                        }]
                      }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn
            connectionDetails:
              - name: roleArn
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn

          - name: irsa-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
              # Least privilege: explicit actions, resource-scoped to this bucket only - AC4
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucket.name
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucket.name
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Sid": "ListAppBucket",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s"
                          },
                          {
                            "Sid": "RWAppObjects",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [
                              "s3:GetObject",
                              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
                              "s3:PutObject",
                              "s3:DeleteObject"
                            ],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                          }
                        ]
                      }

    - step: ready
      functionRef: { name: function-auto-ready }
```

> Note on the encryption patch: the two-step transform above is fiddly. If you prefer clarity over cleverness, ship **two Compositions** (`xappstack-aws-sse-s3`, `xappstack-aws-sse-kms`) selected by `compositionSelector` on `environment`, and hardcode `sseAlgorithm` in each base. Both satisfy AC1.

---

## 6. Claims

`claims/dev.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigName: aws-dev
  bucket:
    name: acme-webapp-assets-dev
  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.micro
    allocatedStorage: 20
    multiAZ: false
    backupRetentionDays: 7
    subnetGroupName: dev-db-subnets
    vpcSecurityGroupIds: [sg-0dev...]
    passwordSecretRef:
      namespace: dev
      name: webapp-db-master        # created by ESO/SOPS, not committed
      key: password
  serviceAccount:
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV123
    oidcProviderHost: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV123
    namespace: dev
    name: webapp
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-db-conn            # rendered secret, stays in-cluster
```

```yaml
    replicaRegion: us-west-2

    instanceClass: db.t3.medium
    allocatedStorage: 100
    multiAZ: true
    backupRetentionDays: 30
    subnetGroupName: prod-db-subnets
    vpcSecurityGroupIds: [sg-0prod...]
    passwordSecretRef:
      namespace: prod
      name: webapp-db-master
      key: password
  serviceAccount:
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRD456
    oidcProviderHost: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRD456
    namespace: prod
    name: webapp
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-db-conn
```

## Acceptance criteria mapping

| AC | Where |
|---|---|
| 1 — bucket versioning/SSE/no public | `bucket-versioning`, `bucket-encryption`, `bucket-public-access-block` |
| 2 — RDS protection/backups/private | `deletionProtection: true`, `publiclyAccessible: false`, XRD `minimum: 7` on `backupRetentionDays` |
| 3 — secret never plaintext | `passwordSecretRef` → pre-existing Secret from ESO/SOPS; connection details written to in-cluster Secret only |
| 4 — least privilege | `irsa-policy` has explicit actions, ARN-scoped; trust condition pins `sub` to one namespace/SA |
| 7 — env isolation | separate `ProviderConfig` (separate AWS accounts) + separate claim namespaces; no shared state object |

## Gaps vs. the canonical spine

- **EKS cluster, CloudFront/ACM, S3 CRR** are not composed here (task scoped to bucket/RDS/IAM). `spec.bucket.replicaRegion` is accepted but unused — add a `BucketReplicationConfiguration` + replication `Role` resource pair, gated by a second Composition, to close it.
- The KMS-vs-AES256 patch is the one place the patch-and-transform DSL fights you; `function-go-templating` or two Compositions is cleaner if you're willing to add a function.
